artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Offline adapter: reads the custody source's silver holdings and transactions through opal_naming.address(), writes one parquet to .scratch; S3 reads only; no firm token, firm resolved by lookup('z09'). Not moved into a pipeline tree.
The adapter's source declaration as data; vendor column names live only here.
Compounds the adapter's daily returns over each reported window and compares at 0.35 pp; classes every miss; writes the record.

The record: source blackdiamond, comparison_source commonwealth, 61 accounts, denominator 61, within 0, 61 classed misses keyed by hashed account, output_columns read from the parquet, output_sha256 86cec8f7a7aacdebe896a0120537b047370a1eedc09cdbdee140277a7b0dd43f. The parquet itself stays in .scratch, uncommitted.

declared_exclusions.item: A same-window tie of the adapter's arithmetic against the reported source
declared_exclusions.reason: No Commonwealth-reported window overlaps the source's value coverage for the same account (row IRPT_DASHBD-W48-S1), so within=0 measures that gap, not the arithmetic. Guard against holdings price return and the measured large-flow threshold are also not reached offline (row W48-S2).
